## Combo 74-3609--127
Cards: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment + Magistrate's Scepter
Color identity: U | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 750 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Requires: Spacecraft (exile: exiled by Locus of Enlightenment)
Start: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment (battlefield); Magistrate's Scepter (exile: exiled by Locus of Enlightenment)
Prerequisites: Untapped creatures you control have total power 2 or greater.
Steps: Activate Locus of Enlightenment using the Spacecraft's station ability by tapping a creature with power 1 or greater.
  Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying its ability from step 1.
  Resolve both Locus of Enlightenment abilities, putting a number of charge counters on it equal to twice the tapped creature's power.
  If needed, repeat from step 1 until Locus of Enlightenment has three or more charge counters on it.
  Activate Locus of Enlightenment using Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

Cards: Thousand-Faced Shadow + Cloudstone Curio + Great Whale
Color identity: U | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 16 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB
Start: Thousand-Faced Shadow (hand); Cloudstone Curio (battlefield); Great Whale (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control at least one other creature that can attack this turn.
  You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}.
  Great Whale does not have summoning sickness.
  An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
Steps: Declare Great Whale and any other creature as attackers.
  When they are unblocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}.
  Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning the other attacking creature to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.

  Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
  Resolve the Thousand-Faced Shadow trigger, creating a token copy of Great Whale.

  Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
  Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand.
  Repeat from step 2.

Color identity: U | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 1600 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {8}{U} at most each turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Skip your draw steps; Lock
Start: Ghostly Flicker (hand); Mystic Sanctuary (battlefield); Time Stretch (hand); Archaeomancer (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
Steps: Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
  Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
  Move to your first extra turn.
  Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
  Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Archaeomancer.
  When Archaeomancer and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
  Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
  Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
  Repeat.

## Combo 957-2493-7879
Cards: Jin-Gitaxias // The Great Synthesis + Time Stretch + Archaeomancer
Color identity: U | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 470 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {3}{U} each other turn
Produces: Near-infinite turns; Lock
Start: Jin-Gitaxias // The Great Synthesis (battlefield: with two lore counters on it); Time Stretch (hand); Archaeomancer (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
Steps: At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Archaeomancer without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
  Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
  Resolve the Archaeomancer spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
  Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
  When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
  Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Archaeomancer) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
  Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
Notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

  However, Marjhan cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
  Marjhan triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

  Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
  Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
  Repeat each turn.
